name: Sao Tome and Principe
summary: The Civil Code (Book V) reserves a legítima for compulsory heirs and bars a testator from disposing of it (arts. 2156-2157). The fractions were not retrieved. Rules for foreigners, trusts and foundations were not sourced.
reserved_share: Arts. 2156-2157 Civil Code: the testator cannot dispose of the legítima, reserved for compulsory heirs. Fractions not retrieved (Portugal's should not be assumed).
trust_note: No trust or private-foundation law was found; answers provisional.
open_questions: Conflict rule for foreigners not found.

Hague Trusts Convention: The HCCH status table (checked 2026-10-16) lists 14 Contracting Parties; this country is not one of them and no UK, Dutch or Chinese extension covers it, so the 1985 Convention is not in force here.
